conclusion: Initial cache load invokes slots3,2,1,0. Same-column south loads before north. Actual F0ED00 insert-before-equal-z reverses source insertion, so equal-depth overlapping north records draw before south for this initial-load path. Within each block source records also reverse.
scope: Unmodified x86 loop and F0ED00 execute in Unicorn. Map loading calls are intercepted only to record slot arguments; malloc/memcpy/memmove/delete emulated as ordinary memory helpers. No original process/network. This does not yet prove incremental cache shift/reinsertion order or whole native renderer.
